description: Single backend command-dispatch surface for the IDE/Tauri layer. Commands: inspect_workspace, route_model, diagnose_dry_run, diagnose_live_opt_in, generate_patch_plan_opt_in, verify_temp_patch, get_repair_state, get_human_approval_packet. Read-only/status commands cannot mutate source. Live commands require opt_in. Patch commands operate temp-only. Approval packet command does not approve.
purpose: Rung 7 of the IDE consumer campaign.
